name: intent-formation
description: Help people form and revise intent while working with Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Clarify intent only when it changes the next step.
interface.longDescription: A quiet intent-formation loop for Codex: continue when the task is clear, ask one useful question before a costly divergent branch, offer concrete comparisons when the user lacks vocabulary, and use a small sample when preference is easier to form from a result.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me figure out what I want while we work on this task.
